items.source: If the given resource name is an absolute path (i.e., starts with a leading slash), the supplied type will be ignored. For example, forResource(org.example.MyClass, "/myResource.txt") will match against "myResource.txt".
items.translation: 如果给定的资源名称是绝对路径（即以开头的斜杠开头），则提供的类型将被忽略。例如，`forResource(org.example.MyClass, "/myResource.txt")` 将匹配 `"myResource.txt"`。

items.source: A leading slash will be removed.
